title: [Hummings.com] Table Flowers Arrangement - Scarlet Rise (KTA587B)
description:
Table Flowers Arrangement - Scarlet Rise (KTA587B)
Illuminate any space with our exquisitely designed floral collection that are crafted with passion and expertise!

This arrangement consists of:
• Red Anthuriums
• Red Ginger
• Red Hydrangeas
• Hypericums
• Red Carnations
• Mini Fruits
• Roman Pillar Vase (Approx: H24cm)
• Approx. H:75cm x W:60cm

Humming Flowers & Gifts reserves the right to replace any item with another of equivalent value depending on availability.
Subsequent re-delivery will incur an additional charge of $10.90 per delivery.
